entries.text: 我是热血沸腾的凰檗！\n让我们一起燃烧斗志吧！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_first_01

entries.text: 嘿呀！转学生！\n是你叫我来的，对吧？[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp01_00

entries.text: 能够在新的职场进行挑战，\n我对此兴奋不已啊！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp01_01

entries.text: 我会被叫到这里来，\n应该是有什么理由吧！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp01_02

entries.text: 你希望从我这里\n得到什么呢！？[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp01_03

entries.text: 热血精神
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp01_select_01

entries.text: 知识
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp01_select_02

entries.text: 只要你人在就好
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp01_select_03

entries.text: 哦哦！那是我擅长的领域！\c\n就用我的热血精神来让蓝莓学园\n燃烧起热烈的氛围吧！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp01_04

entries.text: 哦哦！原来你对我的\n对战学知识抱有期待啊！\c\n这里不愧是注重宝可梦对战的学园！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp01_04b

entries.text: 那是什么理由啊！\n你怎么了，转学生！？\r\n你果然还是在讴歌青春吗！？[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp01_04c

entries.text: 不论如何，\n都包在热血沸腾的凰檗我身上吧！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp01_05

entries.text: 就当是挂在铁掌力士的肩膀上，\n你尽管放心吧！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp01_06

entries.text: 转学生！\n生态巨蛋真棒啊！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp02_00

entries.text: 我发现，\n巨蛋就相当于是学院的操场！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp02_01

entries.text: 这里非常宽阔，\n特别适合用来跑步练习呢！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp02_02

entries.text: 我正考虑下堂课\n用实践的形式绕巨蛋跑一圈呢。\r\n你觉得如何啊？[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp02_03

entries.text: 不错啊！
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp02_select_01

entries.text: 那样的话有点……
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp02_select_02

entries.text: 嗯！腰腿能得到锻炼，\n肯定是百利而无一害的！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp02_04

entries.text: 你觉得还是太过头了吗？\n好像就只有我想跑一样！\c\n真没办法……那就改为跑半圈吧！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp02_04b

entries.text: 当然，\n我会让你也一起来体验的！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp02_05

entries.text: 这个学园的学生\n真是充满了干劲啊！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp03_00

entries.text: 来上对战学课程的学生，\n注意力真是不同凡响！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp03_01

entries.text: 听说在这个学园，\n越是和战斗有关的课程，\r\n成绩的占比就越高！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp03_02

entries.text: 只要擅长宝可梦对战，就有希望\n当联盟职员，加入巡护员部队，\r\n或是成为专业的训练家哦！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp03_03

entries.text: 超多的梦想！
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp03_select_01

entries.text: 真的吗！？
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp03_select_02

entries.text: 当然，你的目标也可以是成为\n像我一样的对战学老师哦！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp03_04

entries.text: 唔唔！你是第一次听说吗！？\c\n你不知情，居然还能当上冠军，\n可见你是打心眼里喜欢宝可梦啊！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp03_04b

entries.text: 不管是对战学，还是任何事物，\n只要努力学习，\r\n就能拥有无限的选择！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp03_05

entries.text: 为了将来不后悔，\n你要好好学习啊，转学生！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp03_06

entries.text: ……我好像有点\n在对你说教的感觉啊！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_trade_01_00

entries.text: 不论是作为老师还是战友，\n我都会很关注你哦。[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_trade_01_01

entries.text: 为了促进我们的感情，\n来交换宝可梦吧！？[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_trade_01_02

entries.text: 好！那我们开始吧！\n我打算选玛沙那！\r\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]，你要选哪个孩子呢？[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_trade_01_03

entries.text:
你选[VAR 0x0101(0001)]啊！
我感觉它挺嘿呀的，真棒！\c
我会每天锻炼它，
让它强到逆天！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_trade_01_04

entries.text: 那么转学生你的[VAR 0x0101(0001)]\n就和我的玛沙那来交换咯！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_trade_02_00

entries.text: 无法使用初训家不是自己的\n宝可梦进行交换。
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_trade_02_01

entries.text: 无法使用稀有宝可梦\n进行交换。
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_trade_02_02

entries.text: 无法使用异色宝可梦\n进行交换。
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_trade_02_03

entries.text:
同行宝可梦只有１只的话，
是不能交换的！\c
等你同行宝可梦有２只以上之后，
再来找我嘿呀吧！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_trade_03_00

entries.text: 现在先不用交换吗？\n等你想嘿呀时再来和我说吧！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_trade_03_01

entries.text: 嘿呀！转学生！\c\n你愿意开始和我\n交换宝可梦了吗！？[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_trade_04_00

entries.text: 嘿呀！转学生！\n你要邀请我打宝可梦对战吗！？[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_talkto_00

entries.text: 唔唔！原来不是啊……\n要对战的话，我随时奉陪！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_cancel_00

entries.text: 我没有任何理由拒绝！\n我们跑去对战场吧！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_battlestart_00

entries.text: [EMPTY 62]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_battlestart_01

entries.text: 不甘心啊……！\n我又被彻底打败了！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_battleend_win_00_00

entries.text: 但是我的收获也很大！\n我会吸取经验，下次一定要赢你！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_battleend_win_00_01

entries.text: 多谢转学生你的关照！\n收下我的心意吧！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_battleend_win_00_02

entries.text: 一口气喝掉攻击增强剂后，\n让我们朝着夕阳嘿呀吧！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_battleend_win_00_03

entries.text: [EMPTY 62]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_reward_00

entries.text: 今天的对战也很棒哦！\n转学生，谢谢你！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_battleend_win_01_00

entries.text: 下次别想像这次一样哦！\n让我们朝着夕阳嘿呀吧！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_battleend_win_01_01

entries.text:
这次是我赢了！
我保住了对战学老师的面子！\c
你就看着大海，
吞下输掉的不甘心吧！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_battleend_lose_00_00

entries.text: 联盟社的活动室里\n挤满了年轻人，\r\n真是青春气息爆棚呀！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_randomtalk_00

entries.text:
其实啊，
我有些害怕坐飞机……\c
所以来蓝莓学园对我来说，
是非常需要气势的一件事！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_randomtalk_01

entries.text:
在对战中也是
可以锻炼身体的！\c
下次对战时就看看我吧！
我就是靠那个动作来提升心肺功能的！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_randomtalk_02

entries.text:
转学生的[VAR 0x0101(0001)]
今天也充满活力！\c
我做的三明治
它也吃得津津有味哦！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_randomtalk_03

entries.text:
我交换给你的玛沙那最近如何！？
那孩子是拳击高手！\c
无论敌人有多强，
它都会用各种各样的拳击将对方击碎！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_randomtalk_04
